eventMetadata.context_description: The closely bunched probabilities for the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs reflect their status as the West's projected frontrunners entering 2026-27, driven by elite young cores around Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams for OKC alongside Victor Wembanyama, De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle for San Antonio. Both clubs used the 2026 draft and offseason moves to add frontcourt size and depth—Oklahoma City selecting Aday Mara while shedding luxury-tax pieces, and San Antonio adding Tobias Harris plus bigs like Jayden Quaintance—after strong 2025-26 performances that included deep playoff runs. Defending champion New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers, bolstered by additions like LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, keep the East competitive, underscoring the parity and health-dependent nature of the title chase.
